selection_policy: Minimum complete val/loss in shared completed-validation window; no test selection.
limitations: Training/validation sum-KL use different per-device batch sizes (16/8); training CAD is cube24 augmented, validation canonical.
Both new encoders move the detached edge-feature teacher; total minus KL is not a fixed geometry-only score.
Validation samples posterior; reconstruction evaluation uses each checkpoint's own mean. Old latent cache/diffusion are not assumed compatible.
Same selected step and shared validation window do not complete the unequal full-run budgets, nor eliminate single-seed uncertainty.
New branch parameter changes demonstrate learning, not output magnitude or causal contribution to final geometry.
No test metric selected checkpoints. Native solid/failure conclusions belong to downstream reports.
